image_decode_contract: HTTPS approved-instance host only; DNS and connected-peer public-IP checks on every redirect; streamed 12 MiB default cap; magic/content-type agreement; OpenCV decoder validation; EXIF orientation applied by IMREAD_COLOR; deterministic BGR working color; 40 MP limit

yunet.preprocessing: OpenCV FaceDetectorYN; BGR decoded image; detector input is exact source width and height
yunet.output: rows of box xywh, five landmarks (right eye, left eye, nose, right mouth, left mouth), confidence
yunet.weight_terms: MIT in the upstream model directory
yunet.checksum_provenance: Frozen from the previously verified official OpenCV Zoo artifact; rechecked locally before load

sface.preprocessing: OpenCV FaceRecognizerSF alignCrop using the five YuNet landmarks; BGR input
sface.weight_terms: Apache-2.0 in the upstream model directory; training provenance remains a documented limitation
sface.checksum_provenance: Frozen from the previously verified official OpenCV Zoo artifact; rechecked locally before load

sscd.preprocessing: BGR to RGB; OpenCV INTER_LINEAR direct 320x320 resize; float32 /255; ImageNet mean/std; no crop
sscd.weight_terms: MIT repository; standalone official TorchScript inference artifact
sscd.checksum_provenance: Downloaded from the official dl.fbaipublicfiles.com URL and frozen before integration

face_parser.preprocessing: context-preserving face crop; BGR to RGB; OpenCV INTER_LINEAR direct 512x512 resize; float32 /255; ImageNet mean/std
face_parser.output: first ONNX output: 19-class logits at 512x512; nearest-neighbor mask restoration
face_parser.weight_terms: MIT repository release artifact; trained on CelebAMask-HQ per upstream README
face_parser.checksum_provenance: Downloaded from the official GitHub release asset and frozen before implementation

five_point_pose_template.mapping: YuNet right/left eye centers are averages of canonical vertices [33,133,159,145] and [362,263,386,374]; nose=1; mouth corners=61,291
five_point_pose_template.contract: Approximate generic-person geometry in centimeters; SOLVEPNP_SQPNP; focal length=max(image dimensions); zero distortion; not calibrated head-pose ground truth
